name: ART REACT XR
summary:
ART REACT XR transforms the way you experience art in virtual reality.
Explore an open virtual gallery featuring works by artists such as Hilma af Klint, Wassily Kandinsky, and Mark Rothko. Move freely through the exhibition, approach artworks at your own pace, and enter immersive spaces designed to help you experience each work from a new perspective.
Rather than altering the original artwork, ART REACT XR expands the environment around it. Changes in scale, lighting, spatial atmosphere, and ambient sound
